component.name: Avatar
component.description: A circular photo that represents a person, such as the signed-in user.

useWhen: Representing the signed-in user in a top navigation bar (size sm)
Displaying the user's profile photo on a settings or profile page (size lg)

notFor.case: Using Avatar for non-person images (e.g. course thumbnails, brand logos)
notFor.because: Avatar's circular crop and fixed sizes are designed for portrait photos. Non-person images lose meaning in this shape.

useWhen.sm: The signed-in user in the AppHeader, or a person named inline in a metadata line.
useWhen.md: A person on a card or in a secondary profile block, such as a course instructor.
useWhen.lg: The profile photo at the top of a settings or profile page.
